reviews.x: So bought these and installed them.  The back seat belt exploded and broke when we hit a bump while my kid was starapped in.  Then a couple days later I went to strap him in again on the other seatbelt in the back and it exploded and broke.  So now within a month of use 2 of 4 are totally broken.  I messaged them to get replacements and have heard nothing back.  If they would have handled this correctly I would have not left this review.  I am very upset as this is an expensive item.  I will be

I needed these to make my Yamaha G29 legal for street use in my city. The kit I got came with instructions to bolt on the bracket the seatbelts attach to but nothing about the seatbelts themselves. To help out future buyers here are some instructions for the seatbelts -  Step 2 (step 1 is installing the main bracket per included instructions) install the male seatbelt mechanisms. They attach on the outside of the cart (like in your car). They bolt on with the included 18 mm bolts, lock washer, a

This is perfect for the Club Car Precedent with the aftermarket rear seat roof bars installed. I have not tried to install it with the factory roof supports so I cannot speak to that installation. Very easy to install and everything worked as it should. I would highly recommend for my specific application. Thanks!
Easy installation and perfect for my four seater precedent!

reviews.t: Need to purchase a bracket for CC Onward
reviews.x: These won't fit out of the box if you have a CC Onward with the factory DoubleTake rear flip seat. The included brackets are too short. I purchased these brackets on Amazon "NATIONAL MFG/SPECTRUM BRANDS HHI N351-453 Mend Brace, 9-1/2-Inch, Black" and was able to make it work.

I was alittle nervous about installing these on my own but the whole process took about 20min. They work great, and I love how they are retractable. Excellent buy, saved myself a huge hassle hiring a golf cart store to do it
Excellent product, works great and keeps the kiddos nice and safe.  Local golf cart shop wanted $250 for same product...uninstalled!

reviews.t: Great fit with plenty of adjustment options
reviews.x: Works as it’s intended to.  I live in a salty area so I will update if issues arise.

I installed this unit on an E-Z-GO golf cart with a rear seat. The hardware is sturdy. Installing some bolts required a little ingenuity because of poor access. I used a pneumatic ratchet with an extension. I could not find a metric or SAE socket to fit the nuts and bolts securely. I don't know what country the nuts and bolts were made in. The belt bolt hole location on the bracket for the rear seat sat too far back to be able to buckle up. I had to move them closer to the rear seat (attached to

When first received, the instructions were missing, I contacted the seller and within the hour we had the written instructions and a video. They installed on our EZGO TXT easily and we have had them for over a month  with at least 3-4 times a week use and so far they are sturdy and easy to use.
The bracket for the back seats needs to be a little longer, or longer seat belts for that bracket. Overall a Great Product. I would buy it again if I need another one.
Put this on for grandkids safety  Bought a second set a week later  We ride it around the farm.  My son drives his cart around his neighborhood with three young girls.
No problems with install, universal design works well for most any cart, love that I no longer have to worry about the kids flying off the cart.
We have 2005 ez go txt refurbished 2015 fit straight out of the box with no modifications needed. Great product, shipping, and easy install!

reviews.t: Easy install on an EZ Go cart
reviews.x: We bought these after market seat belts to keep the grandchildren safe on our rides around our golf and ski resort.  They installed quickly and look great.  The belts function just as you would expect in a car.  With a fold-down rear facing seat, you need to moved them out of the way as they interfere with this operation.  We did cut the stock bolts down and grind the ends smooth, but you could just as easily bought new shorter bolts for this particular install.  The bely tensioner and reel work

reviews.t: Seems to work on 2009 Yamaha G29 4 seater.
reviews.x: Many other similar kits said that they wouldn't work on my particular model of Yamaha.  This one had no such disclaimer, but it did have another review saying that there were some minor modifications needed for a G29.  I purchased the kit expecting to have to make some tweaks, but after taking a first stab at the installation I dont think that I need any tweaking.  It's secure and accessible without blocking the seat from raising up to get to the batteries.  Only minor complaint, it would be nic

1. All the parts aren't in the box.  There are 4 silver nuts/bolts pictured that are for holding the mounting brackets and those were missing.  Ok, that's not a huge, hairy big deal BUT ... 2. If you are looking at the bar that attaches to the back set you'll see that there are slots where the mounting brackets would fit.  Those slots were not wide enough for me to mount on the back seat.  So be sure you know what you are ordering ... if you expect it to fit your cart, please make sure to find o

Did not fit my Yamaha drive as advertised and the directions were horrible. If I followed the instructions provided I would have been unable to use my rear flip seat and the front belts would not be long enough to buckle a 5 year old. My need for seat belts for my kids out weighed my desire to return these so I was able to figure out a way to make them work with modifications.

reviews.t: Took a bit of drilling and cutting in the metal, but it worked out great.
reviews.x: I really like the security of having my grandkids buckled in when I take them for rides in the cart (to keep them from falling/throwing each other out),  so these belts worked well for me.  The bracket didn't fit my cushions exactly, so I had to cut about and inch off of four of them.  I needed to drill some 1/2" holes, too.  But after that, it was great.

Super easy install. Good hardware.  Great value.  Installed on 2013 club car precedent with double take phantom kit.  I installed it on the rear support beam for the rear seat backs.  Drilled two holes in the poly uprights.  Took 20 minutes total. Was dreading the job but was happy with the simplicity.

I have a 2005 EZ-GO TXT and found this product to fit with a slight modification.  I had to drill two 7/16" holes to lift the bar up to the bottom of the front seat backrest.  After that, all went easy.  I should caution that the belts may not fit around a larger adult but for kids it is perfect!

reviews.t: Easy to install works great on my 2017 Club Car Precedent
reviews.x: Easy to install works great on my 2017 Club Car Precedent.  the belts are good quality and retract very well. The flexible ends of the latch portion of the belt tuck easily behind the seat when not in use so it makes using the fold down seat much easier.

Great kit. Put on a 2008 club car Precedent. Would be nicer if it came with longer bolts to fit with the 4 seat golf carts given that its a 4 seatbelt position kit. Either way quick run for longer bolts and it works great. Worth the purchase.

reviews.t: They are a little touchy retracting.
reviews.x: Overall this was a very reasonable product, pretty easy to install on my 2011 club car ds with an unknown rear seat add on.  I was able to easily install it.  If you got a bigger gut than me, it may not be long enough.  36" W in jeans.

reviews.t: Good value for the wife’s peace of mind.
reviews.x: Over all not bad. Easy to install work for the kids downside the strap feels cheap and will get  tighter with every exhale. I have fixed that with a clip so the belt can’t retract and tighten up on you. Not a huge deal.

claims.text: Most buyers find the seat belts easy to install, often completing the job in about 20-30 minutes.
The belts work well and keep children safe, which is the main reason many customers bought them.
The included brackets are sometimes too short or don't fit certain carts out of the box, requiring extra brackets or modification.
Instructions are sometimes missing or incomplete, though seller support was responsive when contacted.
A few customers report the seat belts breaking or exploding during use.
